description: This file defines an abstract base class 'RenderInfo' used for holding rendering-related information within the MigraDoc document rendering system. It contains properties for format info, layout info, and the related document object, along with utility methods.

classes.name: RenderInfo
classes.description: Abstract base class for classes storing rendering information, including format info, layout info, and document object references.

methods.name: RemoveEnding
methods.description: Virtual method intended to remove or finalize the rendering info ending; by default triggers a debug assertion if called.

methods.name: GetTotalHeight
methods.description: Static method calculating the total height of a sequence of RenderInfo objects.
